scripts.guards: npm run guards:backend && npm run guards:frontend
scripts.guards:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run qa:perf && npm --prefix frontend run qa:functional && npm --prefix frontend run qa:api && npm --prefix frontend run qa:contracts && npm --prefix frontend run qa:routes && npm --prefix frontend run qa:composition && npm --prefix frontend run qa:architecture && npm --prefix frontend run test:run
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.qa: npm --prefix backend run check:commercial-ready && npm --prefix frontend run qa
scripts.qa:electron: node --check frontend/electron/main.cjs && node --check frontend/electron/postgres-manager.cjs && node --check frontend/electron/runtime-config.cjs && node scripts/test-electron-update-lifecycle.cjs
scripts.compose:e2e: docker compose up -d postgres backend && bash ./scripts/wait-for-http.sh http://127.0.0.1:3001/health 90 2 && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.qa:release: npm run qa && npm run compose:e2e && npm run package:clean
